verdict.rationale: The evidence shows versioned developer artifacts: ykman 5.9.2 and python-fido2 2.2.1 resolve on public registries, and a public YubiEnterprise REST API documentation page exists. Nothing in the pack describes API versioning semantics or any deprecation or sunset policy for the SDKs or the REST API. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, explicit API versioning (e.g. versioned REST endpoints or semver guarantees), and changelog or compatibility commitments.
